title: Aiko Tanaka (ATANAKA)
summary: Stores team member (STORES) at Manchester under Daniel Okafor, processing goods receipts, cycle count entries, and bay intake.
body:
Aiko Tanaka is an active Stores team member at Northbridge Cycles based in Manchester operating unit NBC-MAN-01 [^r1]. Tanaka reports to [[user-dokafor|Daniel Okafor]] under default cost centre [[cc-prd-05|PRD-05]] and holds a £0 gross approval limit under [[role-stores|role STORES]] [^r1]. In day-to-day operations, Tanaka processes inbound receipts in Ledgerline, coordinates cycle count reconciliation across sites, and serves as a key stores contact for receiving bay management [^r1][^r2][^r15][^r17].

## Responsibilities and system activity

Tanaka records incoming shipments into warehouse WH-MAN-STR against active purchase orders in [[data-grn-register-2026|Ledgerline]] [^r2][^r3]. Recorded receipts include GRN/2026/28618 on 2026-01-10 for 225 units of lacquer LAC-SLV against PO/2026/00001 and delivery note SP/DN/53879, GRN/2026/28622 on 2026-01-17 for 2,000 units of LGT-REB against PO/2026/00003 from supplier WL-CAR-0539, and GRN/2026/28666 on 2026-02-06 for 120,000 units of CHG-4A-01 from supplier CC-SAL-0031 [^r2][^r3][^r4][^r5].

In stocktaking, Tanaka coordinates warehouse cycle counts across both sites, overseeing paperwork collection and entering inventory variance records into the system [^r15]. Warehouse staff are instructed to escalate damaged cartons and inventory count discrepancies directly to Tanaka [^r16]. Tanaka is also tasked with checking the purchase ledger for partial deliveries—such as flagging outstanding balances on brake pad shipments requested by [[user-eclarke|Emma Clarke]] on 2026-07-23—to prevent premature invoice passing prior to final system booking [^r20].

## Operations and storekeeping issues

Tanaka has regularly raised dock intake controls and warehouse flow challenges with management:
* **Unreferenced deliveries**: On 2022-08-26, Tanaka alerted [[user-dokafor|Daniel Okafor]] about deliveries arriving without purchase order numbers on the delivery note, warning that staging unreferenced pallets on the loading bay blocks scheduled intake, impedes invoice matching, and corrupts stock counts [^r13][^r14].
* **Intake bay congestion**: On 2026-03-16, Tanaka reported severe Monday morning congestion at the Manchester receiving bay due to simultaneous haulier arrivals, which led to backlogs of intake paperwork, safe forklift transit restrictions, and hold-ups for the transfer wagon to Leeds [^r17][^r18]. Tanaka proposed spreading haulier delivery slots across the day and adding intake desk staff during morning peak hours [^r19].

## Committee and meeting attendance

Tanaka represents the stores function across cross-functional reviews and operational meetings:
* Attended the 2022-02-10 sales meeting as document owner [^r6].
* Attended the [[topic-it-steering-2022-03-11|IT steering meeting]] on 2022-03-11 [^r7].
* Participated in the [[decision-2023-06-21-packaging-review|packaging review meeting]] on 2023-06-21 regarding split packaging deliveries between Manchester and Leeds and gangway obstruction in goods inwards [^r8].
* Participated in the [[decision-2025-07-24-supplier-review|supplier review meeting]] on 2025-07-24 covering receiving discrepancies and stores packaging standards [^r9].
* Attended the weekly purchasing meeting on 2026-01-24 with [[user-bprice|Bronwen Price]] and [[user-pjansen|Pieter Jansen]] [^r10].
* Attended the [[decision-2026-04-18-stores-and-logistics|stores and logistics meeting]] on 2026-04-18 concerning material issues, Leeds inter-site transfers, customer returns labelling, packaging inventory checks, and Manchester dispatch delays [^r11].
* Represented stores at the [[decision-2026-09-18-ledgerline-key-users|Ledgerline key users meeting]] on 2026-09-18 [^r12].

r13.loc_text: Delivery without a purchase order number
r13.quote: Goods receiving have had another delivery turn up at the gate without a purchase order number on the delivery note.

r14.section: Delivery without a purchase order number
r14.loc_text: Delivery without a purchase order number
r14.quote: leaving unreferenced pallets on the loading dock causes problems with stock counts, blocks access for scheduled deliveries, and makes it difficult for the invoice matching team to reconcile the supplier invoice

r15.quote: We need to complete the full physical check and have the figures keyed into the legacy system before the end of the shift, so your cooperation across both sites is appreciated.

r16.quote: bring any obvious discrepancies or damaged cartons to my attention straight away rather than adjusting the tally yourself.

r17.quote: We are running into serious congestion in the Manchester goods inward bay at the start of each week.

r18.quote: The main difficulty is that receipts cannot be processed into the system quickly enough to clear the floor.

r19.quote: Could we review the delivery slots with the hauliers so their arrivals are spread more evenly across the day?

r20.quote: Could you please monitor the purchase ledger and flag the outstanding balance so that the invoice is not passed for full payment until the second delivery is physically verified and booked in?
